description: The independent control-plane workspace is ready for authorized, database-configured capabilities. No operational modules are configured in application source.

auth.deniedDescription: This account does not have enabled Super Admin access. Contact the platform owner.
auth.empty: No operational modules are available yet.
auth.signInError: Unable to sign in. Check your credentials and try again.
auth.actionError: Unable to complete the session action. Try again.

registry.pending: Adapter operations are not available in this workspace.

transfer.manual: Manual transfer configuration. Payment confirmation remains a manual review; this channel does not verify bank transfers.
transfer.incomplete: Configuration incomplete; payment instructions are unavailable
transfer.saveError: Save was not confirmed. Retry the same request to resolve its outcome; close and reload before making another change.

activity.title: Activity
activity.empty: No observed activity matches these filters
activity.partial: Remote observations are partial and may be stale. Missing records do not prove that no action occurred. Reasons are masked to protect sensitive information.
activity.remoteError: Remote retrieval failed; coverage remains partial.

offers.title: Private offers
offers.manual: Private terms stay outside the public catalog. Redemption requires Shop support for secure links and revocation; payment still requires manual evidence review.
offers.saveError: Save was not confirmed. Retry the same request; close and reload before changing its terms.

billing.manual: Evidence is not bank confirmation. Verify the received transfer externally before approval.
billing.missingTerms: Frozen resource limits are unavailable. Approval is blocked.
billing.noBlockers: No quota blockers reported; Shop rechecks at approval.
billing.approvalBlocked: Approval is blocked by quota usage or incomplete frozen terms. No customer records are changed to bypass a blocker.
billing.evidenceUnavailable: Evidence metadata is unavailable from the payment queue.
billing.evidenceError: Evidence review could not be authorized
billing.verified: I verified the received transfer externally
billing.commandError: Review was not confirmed. Check the reason, verified amount and blockers. Retry the exact request if it was sent; its fields remain locked.

accounts.title: Account activation
accounts.description: Choose an existing trial account and activate its selected plan immediately.
accounts.unavailable: Account controls are unavailable. No activation has been confirmed.
accounts.unconfigured: No account module is configured for this environment.
accounts.consequences: The trial dates remain in history. Access lasts for the chosen plan interval. This admin grant does not record a payment or verify the owner’s email.
accounts.noPayment: Admin activation recorded. No payment or receipt was created.
accounts.keepRequest: Retry this saved request to reconcile the result. Keep its request ID; do not submit a new activation.
accounts.rejected: The target rejected activation. Refresh the account and plan before trying again.
accounts.storageUnavailable: Saved retry storage is unavailable. Activation has not been submitted from this form.
accounts.notTrial: This account is not in a trial. Its existing subscription will not be replaced.
accounts.quotaBlocked: Current usage exceeds the selected plan. Choose a suitable plan or resolve the usage limits.

provision.title: Create and activate an account
provision.description: Provision a new owner account, choose its plan and activate access now. Ownership is claimed separately by email.
provision.unconfigured: Secure provisioning is not configured for this environment.
provision.consequences: This is an audited admin grant with no recorded payment. The owner receives an invitation and chooses their own password; email ownership is not confirmed by this action. Existing emails are not linked or overwritten.
provision.resendConsequences: An earlier send may have succeeded. Sending again can duplicate the email and invalidate earlier links. The existing account and plan are preserved.
provision.acknowledge: I understand and want to send a new invitation.
provision.unknown: The provisioning outcome is uncertain. Retry the saved request to reconcile it.
provision.noActivation: No plan activation has been confirmed for this account.

phases.conflict: That email already has an account. Use existing-account controls or ask its owner to finish signup.
phases.review_required: Provisioning requires review. The reserved identity is retained; no plan activation is confirmed.

invites.sent: Accepted by the email service; delivery is not confirmed
invites.unknown: Send outcome uncertain; reconcile before resending
